CustomField.description: Human-readable price range derived from Price (Min) and Price (Max). This is the string the chatbot quotes, so pricing is never hand-typed into two places.
CustomField.formula: IF(AND(ISBLANK(Price_Min__c), ISBLANK(Price_Max__c)), "Price on request", IF(BLANKVALUE(Price_Max__c, Price_Min__c) >= 10000000, "INR " & TEXT(ROUND(BLANKVALUE(Price_Min__c, Price_Max__c) / 10000000, 2)) & IF(OR(ISBLANK(Price_Max__c), Price_Max__c = Price_Min__c), " Cr", " Cr - " & TEXT(ROUND(Price_Max__c / 10000000, 2)) & " Cr"), "INR " & TEXT(ROUND(BLANKVALUE(Price_Min__c, Price_Max__c) / 100000, 2)) & IF(OR(ISBLANK(Price_Max__c), Price_Max__c = Price_Min__c), " Lakh", " Lakh - " & TEXT(ROUND(Price_Max__c / 100000, 2)) & " Lakh")))
CustomField.label: Price Range
